mapper.sql: ci.id, ci.user_id, ci.product_id, ci.sku_id, ci.quantity, ci.created_at, ci.updated_at, p.shop_id, p.name AS product_name, p.price AS product_price, p.stock AS product_stock, p.status AS product_status, p.version AS product_version, s.status AS shop_status , i.url AS product_image_url, ps.name AS sku_name, ps.price AS sku_price, ps.stock AS sku_stock, ps.status AS sku_status, ps.version AS sku_version
FROM cart_items ci JOIN products p ON p.id = ci.product_id JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_skus ps ON ps.id=ci.sku_id LEFT JOIN images i ON i.id=p.image_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items (user_id, product_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_items SET checkout_id=#{checkoutId}, checkout_claimed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id IN #{id} AND (checkout_id IS NULL OR checkout_id=#{checkoutId})

UPDATE cart_items SET reaper_claimed_by=#{worker}, reaper_claim_until=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE checkout_id IS NOT NULL AND checkout_claimed_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) - INTERVAL 10 SECOND AND (reaper_claim_until IS NULL OR reaper_claim_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY checkout_claimed_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT checkout_id FROM cart_items WHERE checkout_id IS NOT NULL AND reaper_claimed_by=#{worker} AND reaper_claim_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_items SET checkout_id=NULL, checkout_claimed_at=NULL, reaper_claimed_by=NULL, reaper_claim_until=NULL WHERE checkout_id=#{checkoutId}
UPDATE cart_items SET reaper_claimed_by=NULL,reaper_claim_until=NULL WHERE checkout_id=#{checkoutId} AND reaper_claimed_by=#{worker}
